description.zh: 直播流所属应用名称。支持通配符*，代表该域名下所有的AppName。
description.en: The AppName of the live stream. You can specify an asterisk (\*) to match all AppNames under the domain name.

description.zh: 直播流流名称。支持通配符*，代表该AppName下所有的StreamName。
description.en: The name of the live stream. You can use the wildcard (\*) to specify all StreamNames under the AppName.

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为60次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 60. If you exceed the limit, API calls are throttled. This may impact your business. Plan your API calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-delay-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain example.com --app liveApp0000 --stream liveStream0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveDelayConfig --region cn-hangzhou --App liveApp0000 --Stream liveStream0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Domain 'example.com'
